title_original: Roadmap for Revit migrator to Bonsai BIM - absolute beginner
question_paraphrase: Hi, I am an absolute beginner to IFC coming from Revit. What should I learn first to move to Bonsai? I built a small timber house as practice.
context_given: built a small timber house in Blender+Bonsai
phrasing_notes: Greeting, thanks for free resources, self-labelled 'absolute beginner', non-native phrasing
answer_summary: Follow a Blender/Bonsai video tutorial series while building a project.

title_original: I am a beginner!! I created a file in Bonsai but it doesn't appear correctly in 3D in Revit
question_paraphrase: House exported from Bonsai looks fine in Blender and some viewers, but in Revit wall heights and door/window positions are lost and elements vanish. Is there an export setting that fixes it?
phrasing_notes: Self-label 'beginner!!' in title, double exclamation, asks for one setting as magic fix
answer_summary: Walls cut by roof/openings break differently per viewer; use half-space solids or recreate the cut, test in more than one viewer.

title_original: BlenderBIM in university curriculum
question_paraphrase: Teaching openBIM with BlenderBIM for the first time after years of Revit; which other educators use it? Course must stay software-neutral and there are no Portuguese textbooks.
phrasing_notes: Educator voice, mentions national laws and language gap
answer_summary: Peers advised adding a short overview of the open-source BIM ecosystem (BlenderBIM, FreeCAD, IFC.js, IfcOpenShell).

title_original: Beginners' IFC Course - Free, available
question_paraphrase: A member proposed listing free IFC/MVD video courses on the wiki; others objected that registration was needed, the content looked sparse or misleading, and it felt promotional.
phrasing_notes: Community debate on quality and self-promotion of learning material
answer_summary: Course could be listed under learning resources with a note about registration.

title_original: How to check if parameters in an IFC file are compliant and editable
question_paraphrase: Calculation software exports IfcMaterial in a custom property set which the BIM manager rejects. How to check conformity to standard psets and move it?
context_given: checks planned in Solibri or BIMCollab
phrasing_notes: Does not say GUI vs Python; no sample file at first
answer_summary: Read psets with IfcOpenShell, create IfcMaterial and associate it; consult OSArch material guides.

title_original: Extracting IFC geometry from beam and column
question_paraphrase: How do I get the cross-section dimensions of beams and columns in an IFC wall when they are Sweep Solid or B-rep? Parse Representation or build a mesh?
phrasing_notes: Cannot share the file; describes approach in steps
answer_summary: Vertices alone are insufficient; merge coplanar faces and find the single N-gon face.

title_original: What are the various use cases of IfcGroup
question_paraphrase: What is IfcGroup actually for beyond copying sets of entities?
phrasing_notes: Short conceptual question
answer_summary: Groups collect elements under an arbitrary concept outside the spatial tree.

title_original: Composite Wall in Bonsai BIM
question_paraphrase: Coming from Blender, can Bonsai make composite walls with layers, materials and thicknesses? Layers do not show in other viewers.
phrasing_notes: Friendly, emoticons, links to videos
answer_summary: Layer sets work but per-layer materials unsupported; wall thickness is derived from layers; viewer support varies.

title_original: IfcSpace and BlenderBim
question_paraphrase: How do I make an IfcSpace bounded by walls whose volume updates when walls change? The Space Boundaries list is empty. Later: how do I split one open room into two spaces?
phrasing_notes: Long-running thread; user says the AddBoundary button is unclear
answer_summary: No automatic boundary association initially; later versions create spaces from walls, but some quantities still manual.

title_original: Understanding IFC Alignment and Rail - Beginners guide
question_paraphrase: Helping a master's thesis: how to place railway elements along an alignment and where to learn how geometry relates to instances in IFC?
phrasing_notes: Asks for a call; admits not knowing the domain
answer_summary: Use IFC 4.3 docs (Alignment Layout, Product Linear Placement), not 4.2; guide still incomplete.

title_original: IfcCurtainWall
question_paraphrase: Glass conference-room partition with mullions and a door: IfcWall or IfcCurtainWall, given the definition of hanging from slab edge?
phrasing_notes: Quotes the definition and doubts it
answer_summary: Use IfcWall; building context determines classification.

title_original: Correct Use of IFC Name and Reference (deprecated?)
question_paraphrase: German office asks how to use Name, Reference and ObjectType consistently; Reference is deprecated in 4.3, and Allplan cannot create USERDEFINED types.
phrasing_notes: Several numbered sub-questions; vendor confirmed limitation
answer_summary: Name identifies the instance, type name belongs on the type; avoid deprecated concepts, use IFC4.

title_original: IFC - Questions from a beginner
question_paraphrase: New to BIM, building a Unity LCA app: where to learn IFC, do element IDs persist across exports, how to read IFC independent of authoring software?
phrasing_notes: Programmer new to AEC; lists several questions
answer_summary: GUIDs mostly persist for elements; use IfcOpenShell or xBIM; export is slow on big projects.

title_original: Education and Training for New IFC users
question_paraphrase: How do firms and universities train newcomers to the IFC spec: hand over the spec, textbooks, or mentoring?
phrasing_notes: Collegial; notes bSI portal too general
answer_summary: Recommended IFC Implementation Guidance and the IFC2x3 Model Implementation Guide.

title_original: Difference between expectations and reality of IFC Standards
question_paraphrase: Revit exports similar walls inconsistently as IfcWall or IfcWallStandardCase; layer data missing for thermal analysis; questions how interoperability can claim success.
phrasing_notes: Candid, non-native phrasing, rhetorical doubt about BIM
answer_summary: Both valid in CV2.0; define custom MVD or export settings; contact Autodesk.

title_original: IFC materials
question_paraphrase: How can a non-expert list every material in an IFC model given IfcMaterial, LayerSet, ProfileSet, ConstituentSet?
phrasing_notes: Hopes for single entity; 'anyone?' closer
answer_summary: Entities reflect usage (layers, profiles, constituents); follow IfcRelAssociatesMaterial.

title_original: IFC Documantation
question_paraphrase: Beginner asks why Assign model view is missing in IfcDoc as in the tutorial video, and for resources to learn IFC.
phrasing_notes: Typo in title ('Documantation'), non-native phrasing
answer_summary: Use online IFC4 spec; xBIM and IfcOpenShell; IfcDoc UI changed, manual workflow outlined.

title_original: IFC Schema
question_paraphrase: How do I begin learning IFC? I cannot find a structured guide online.
phrasing_notes: Two-sentence question
answer_summary: Use IFC Implementation Guidance on buildingSMART Technical.

title_original: General usability review from a beginner
question_paraphrase: Maintainers collect a recorded beginner session with annotated feedback to improve UX and prevent beginner mistakes.
phrasing_notes: Maintainer note
answer_summary: Track UX improvements across bugs.

title_original: Web site documentation is missing and confusing
question_paraphrase: Docs lack pages for slabs, roofs and stairs, sidebar hierarchy unclear, duplicate titles, beginner tutorials text only without images.
phrasing_notes: Numbered list of gripes, polite
answer_summary: Major docs overhaul planned.

title_original: Newbie - UI - Ease of Use - Type Changing - EG Wall
question_paraphrase: Let users change a wall's type next to height and length to reduce clicks for complete freshies; add warning when many walls change.
phrasing_notes: Informal, 'freshies', addresses maintainer by first name
answer_summary: Discussed in OSArch chat.

title_original: Confused with property reading | c++
question_paraphrase: How do I get all properties and quantities (length, area) of IfcDuctSegment instances; unsure how to relate IfcQuantityLength to the element.
phrasing_notes: Emoji-heavy, two candidate approaches
answer_summary: Traverse IsDefinedBy to IfcRelDefinesByProperties, then RelatingPropertyDefinition (pset or element quantity).

title_original: IfcOpenshell.org C++ examples are empty
question_paraphrase: C++ examples on the website are empty; asks for hello-world style beginner tutorials like Python has.
phrasing_notes: Offers to help test as C++ newbie
answer_summary: Contributors request community-written examples.

title_original: Export IFC - IfcWall and IfcWallStandardCase
question_paraphrase: IfcWall lacks BaseQuantities unlike IfcWallStandardCase; forcing the class does not help. Is this normal?
phrasing_notes: Ends with initials, 'Thank you in advance'
answer_summary: Linked Autodesk thread; cut geometry in a wall changes exported class.

title_original: Revit incorrectly uses the ObjectType attribute
question_paraphrase: Revit puts the type name in ObjectType, so IFC beginners think it is the IFC type name; this confusion arises every time the openBIM course is taught.
phrasing_notes: Educator reporting a recurring classroom confusion
answer_summary: Autodesk first said fixed in Revit 2026, then retracted after finding a non-public build.

title_original: How to export concrete cover value from a concrete element to an IFC from Revit
question_paraphrase: Concrete cover is exported as a string name; needs numeric depth property or Pset_ConcreteElementGeneral.
phrasing_notes: 'I have had this doubt since forever' - venting
answer_summary: Not reproduced in Revit 2023-2025; value exports.

title_original: IfcExportAs doesn't seem to be exported as a regular pset
question_paraphrase: Eight convoluted rules decide the exported IFC class; IfcExportAs is not visible in psets so wrong classes are hard to audit.
phrasing_notes: Refers to OSArch wiki page
answer_summary: By design; group the parameter elsewhere to see it.

title_original: INQ: How to export Revit Category as Revit user defined property set?
question_paraphrase: Custom property set mapping file: Category, Revit Category etc produce nothing.
phrasing_notes: Structured issue form
answer_summary: Known Jira issue, open; Dynamo workaround.

title_original: Where are the Revit shared parameters installed?
question_paraphrase: Manual says IFC shared parameter files are in ProgramData; folder not found. How are users meant to discover them?
phrasing_notes: Cites manual paragraph
answer_summary: Download from GitHub; docs unclear.

title_original: IfcOpenShell の遅延読み込み

answer_summary: Lazy load cut load time 11.3s to 1.4s on a 393 MB file.

prompt: i just opened my first ifc for uni, what even is in it? can you give me a simple overview, like how many walls doors etc and the storeys

prompt: my prof says walls should be IfcWall but i see IfcWallStandardCase and some IfcWall, why? list which is which
expected_behavior: Count IfcWall vs IfcWallStandardCase, list examples, explain CV2.0 rules and that StandardCase is deprecated in IFC4.

prompt: what is ObjectType vs the actual type of this wall? it shows the revit type name, is that the ifc type??
expected_behavior: Show ObjectType, PredefinedType, IfcRelDefinesByType type entity for the selected wall; explain differences.

prompt: list all materials in the model and say if they are IfcMaterial, layer sets or constituents. for my assignment
expected_behavior: Traverse IfcRelAssociatesMaterial, group by material entity kind, output table.

prompt: check that all doors have FireRating and IsExternal filled in, and tell me which ones dont. beginner level pls

expected_behavior: Create pset and property on the named slab, save to new file, explain steps and entities created.

prompt: exported from blender bim, walls with roof cuts missing in revit. whats wrong with the file

prompt: where should a total newbie start with ifc? i know revit a bit, no coding
expected_behavior: Recommend buildingSMART intro material, OSArch learn resources, a viewer, then optionally Bonsai; step plan.
